title: 刘俊贝：AI资本开支不再是好指标，关注受益者
speaker: Junbelio

segments.en: If CapEx was formerly the best indicator for the AI trade, what is that indicator now? Look, CapEx is still, it's a very important indicator, but what that is saying is that for the upcoming next five to ten years, or even longer, that it underpins in terms of what's going into that space.
segments.zh: 如果资本开支曾是AI交易的最佳指标，现在是什么？资本开支仍然很重要，它预示着未来五到十年甚至更长时间的资金投入方向。

segments.en: And so all the companies, what investors looking for, is really all the companies that will benefit from that. It's actually not the company who's spending the CapEx. So investors not sitting there, if you're spending quite a lot of CapEx, then we're going to invest in your shares, whether which language model is going to win out at the ultimate ease, becoming harder, cool for the investors, because everyone is investing a lot of money.
segments.zh: 投资者寻找的是受益公司，而不是花钱的公司。不会因为某家公司资本开支大就买入，毕竟大家都在大笔投入，最终哪个语言模型胜出更难判断。

segments.en: You remember those companies, hyperscalers, their return will start to deteriorate in the next few years as the depreciation comes through, as some of those CapEx really hitting their P&L. You know, our view is that don't sit in these names, they start going into other businesses. And so valuation is becoming a bigger concern for you? Yeah, absolutely.
segments.zh: 超大规模企业的回报未来几年会因折旧和资本开支侵蚀利润而承压。我们的观点是不要持有这些股票，转向其他业务。估值问题越来越重要？是的。

segments.en: Yeah, absolutely. Look, I think it's across all the markets, we start seeing valuation becoming issue, simply because we've seen the race cycles now moving up, absolutely towards the up now. We've seen a lot of central banks that are moving the interest rate to the high level, Fed may or may not, but we're certainly expecting at least one this year now. So that one, that means is the valuation is not going to expand, expansion story is done.
segments.zh: 所有市场都面临估值问题，因为利率周期在上升，许多央行维持高利率，美联储今年至少降息一次。这意味着估值扩张的故事已经结束。

segments.en: It has to be an earning story, you know, for the earning story to take place, it's less likely to be the larger, you know, if it's in the US market, less likely to be the larger hyperscalers because, you know, the earnings perhaps will be under pressure because of the investment that's going into it. Talk to what the resource angle of AI here, and how that features, particularly in markets like Australia, for example, where you have a big commodity sort of presence.
segments.zh: 现在必须是盈利故事，但大型超大规模企业盈利可能因投资而承压。聊聊AI的资源角度，比如澳大利亚这样的大宗商品市场。
